attchmntText: Creative Eye Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Creative Eye Limited published its un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, in The Free Press Journal and Navshakti on November 14, 2026. The company filed this notice with the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The filing was signed by Manoj Ramesh Kalgutkar, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The document includes detailed financial tables and notes regarding the company's performance for the specified period.

attchmntText: Creative Eye Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Creative Eye Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 13th November 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 47.26 lakhs. The company reported a loss after tax of 10.31 lakhs for the quarter. For the half year, revenue from operations was 30.05 lakhs. The half year loss after tax was 20.60 lakhs. Earnings per share were negative 0.05 for the quarter and negative 0.10 for the half year. Total assets stood at 2331.34 lakhs as at 30th September 2026. Equity was 1453.90 lakhs. The independent auditor issued a review report stating no material misstatements were found.
